snippet.title: 【Indie Game】Yume Kakigori Official Trailer
snippet.description:
More Details: store.steampowered.com/app/2795660/Yume_Kakigori

After two years of wholehearted development, we are looking forward to delivering this hand crafted artwork to you ── unfold emotions in shaved ice, a journey of self-discovery.
Yume Kakigori is a unique visual novel featuring Japanese shaved ice and customer interaction.
Players take on the role of a shaved ice shop owner who has lost their ability to speak.
Guided by the mysterious Raven, you will express yourself through shaved ice and gradually uncover the truths behind the characters and the world.

Each of these characters comes with their own unique backstory and hidden clues embedded in the documents you’ll encounter. Players are invited to explore their stories and piece together the fragments of a mysterious universe. As they explore each customer's story, players will also confront their own emotions, embarking together on a journey of self-discovery.
